name: Flying Leo
summary:
Take to the skies aboard one of Leonardo da Vinci's legendary flying machines in Flying Leo. As the titular Leo you will get to choose from a glider design or a helicopter design and fly through numerous levels collecting treasures and bonuses. Flight is aided by wind currents visible on screen which will give you lift or direction. The glider is only capable of using the currents for air but the helicopter has the added ability of vertical lift with a mouse click.

Some of the things you will encounter in the levels include treasures such as coins and treasure chests that you will have to fly through to pick-up. Bonuses in the levels range from; coin attractor's which will draw treasures to Leo, to invincibility spheres which will protect you from enemies. Lastly the enemies in question range from; Pegasus, giant birds and serpents to cannons firing at you. The one other thing to be on the lookout for, naturally, is the ground. Once you've collected all you need for the level you must guide Leo through the giant mirror to advance to the next level.
